method.name: project_ray_to_camera_plane
method.description:
Projects a 3D ray in Godot camera space onto the camera plane (Z = 0 plane in camera space).
p_origin_cam Ray origin in camera space (millimeters). p_direction_cam Unit ray direction in camera space. Vector3 Intersection point on camera plane, or (NAN, NAN, NAN) if parallel or behind the camera.
Ray origin in camera space (millimeters).
Unit ray direction in camera space.
Vector3 Intersection point on camera plane, or (NAN, NAN, NAN) if parallel or behind the camera.

method.name: project_ray_to_canvas
method.description:
Projects a 3D ray in Godot camera space onto the physical display surface and transforms the hit position into canonical 2D Viewport Canvas space (or relative to a specified CanvasItem).
Automatically accounts for physical camera offsets, screen size and pitch from the active GazeDeviceProfile, the current window position on screen, and display DPI scaling.
p_origin_cam Ray origin in camera space (millimeters). p_direction_cam Unit ray direction in camera space. p_local_to Optional CanvasItem (Node2D or Control). If null (default), returns position in canonical root Viewport Canvas coordinates. If specified, transforms the point into the local space of that CanvasItem. Vector2 Intersection point in canvas space or local coordinates, or (NAN, NAN) if no intersection.
Ray origin in camera space (millimeters).
Unit ray direction in camera space.
Optional CanvasItem (Node2D or Control). If null (default), returns position in canonical root Viewport Canvas coordinates. If specified, transforms the point into the local space of that CanvasItem.
Vector2 Intersection point in canvas space or local coordinates, or (NAN, NAN) if no intersection.

method.name: project_ray_to_viewport
method.description:
Projects a 3D ray in Godot camera space onto the physical display surface and returns window-relative logical points.
Returns coordinates in unscaled window points before Viewport canvas transformation.
p_origin_cam Ray origin in camera space (millimeters). p_direction_cam Unit ray direction in camera space. Vector2 Intersection point in window logical points, or (NAN, NAN) if no intersection.
Ray origin in camera space (millimeters).
Unit ray direction in camera space.
Vector2 Intersection point in window logical points, or (NAN, NAN) if no intersection.
